name: Buyer Questions
description: The shopping questions buyers ask an agent, in their words, with the products that should be the answer.

label.zh-CN: 加一个买家会问的问题

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the buyer question I describe, in the buyer's own words, with its market, intent, priority and the SKUs that should answer it.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后把我描述的买家问题加进来：用买家的原话，写上市场、意图、优先级，以及应该被推荐的 SKU。

label.en: Where are we missing on high-priority questions?
label.zh-CN: 高优先级问题里，我们在哪些地方没被推荐？

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then list the high-priority questions where our product was not shown by any agent in the latest check, and who was picked instead.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后列出最近一次检查里，我们在哪些高优先级问题上没被任何智能体推荐，以及被推荐的是谁。

label.en: Suggest questions from our product range
label.zh-CN: 根据我们的商品线建议要追踪的问题

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then suggest five buyer questions worth tracking for the products I name, phrased the way a shopper would ask an agent. Propose them; do not add them until I pick.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后针对我点名的商品，建议五个值得追踪的买家问题，用消费者问智能体的口吻来写。先给我挑，挑完再加。
